name: celorus
description: Sales intelligence on Indian companies and the people behind them. Run the sales workday: open the day, order today's calls with the reason for each, research a lead in one pass, review the call, queue the follow-up; the desk's context stays in your own folder, and the workday is free: it reads the desk on this machine without signing in, and each change it makes to the desk asks for a free Celorus sign-in before it is made. Then the record: a financial-health report, a cap table and ownership view, a director or leadership profile, or a straight answer to one specific question, for growth work and for diligence. Every record figure is read from the official record and carries its source; web findings are labelled as web findings; what is not established is said plainly, never estimated. Deepest coverage: Indian companies. Includes the celorus-design skill: every artifact you make (HTML, docs, decks, dashboards, spreadsheets, PDFs) follows the Celorus design language.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code notes for the Celorus skills:

- The record comes ONLY from the celorus-data MCP tools. Every skill's own page says whether it needs a Celorus account and what to do without one: follow the page. Never fill a gap in the record from general knowledge or from memory, and never estimate a figure; a Celorus answer with an uncited number in it is a defect, not a partial answer.
- A line from the web is never a record line: it carries its link, the date it was read and the word web on that same line, as research-lead writes it.
- Call the MCP tools by their exposed names in this session (they carry Kimi's `mcp__celorus-data__` prefix); the skills name them without the prefix.
- The workday skills (install-desk, day-open, triage, research-lead, call-review, follow-up, check-desk) read and write the desk folder, the folder that holds celorus/index.md: the one CELORUS_DESK names, or else the first one above your working directory. Kimi starts the desk tools in the plugin folder, so they cannot see your working directory and never look for a desk above it: pass the desk folder's full path as `desk` to every desk tool, unless CELORUS_DESK is set to that full path. A relative path is refused. A desk tool answers a page's full path only when you passed `desk`; with the desk from CELORUS_DESK, every path it answers is relative to that desk folder, so show the page from there. Kimi runs no session hook, so open the day by saying "open my day".
- research-lead's web register uses Kimi's own web search and fetch tools and labels every line it writes from them as web, unverified, with the URL and the date. If this session has no search tool, it says so and skips the web register.
- Kimi Code has no inline artifact viewer. Where a skill offers an artifact-or-floor choice, take the floor: render the markdown + emoji table from the structured `presentation` payload rather than embedding `html_fragment`.
- A request for an actual file (report, deck, workbook, PDF) still goes to `generate_collateral`. Do not hand-build one, and do not reach for a generic document skill; that drifts the brand and re-derives the figures.
- When a skill says to write branded HTML yourself (the celorus-design skill), write it to a file in the working directory and give the user the path.
